reader-reflow-stop-report.mechanism: Actual Activity orientation change and ON_STOP with pending native writer; not process death or an isolated ON_STOP-only trigger

sqlite-full-report.mechanism: Native SQLite max_page_count plus test-only growth trigger; not filesystem ENOSPC

reader-query-error-report.mechanism: temporary query-column rename; native SQLite query failure

reader-locator-error-report.mechanism: test-only malformed locator JSON; real Room repository decoding

reader-reopen-report.mechanism: Native writer held through five actual UI open/restore/close cycles; release then reopen and save

reader-delete-decoding-report.mechanism: Real 32MiB managed TXT decode; AppViewModel deletion request during partial cache; not a visible Reader delete-button flow

reader-switch-report.mechanism: Held production Room writer connection; actual UI scroll/back/open; no fake save result

continuous-progress-report.measurement: Monotonic real-time touch and independent Room observations; not SQL write-ack latency
